original_issue.thesis: Humanoid robotics' visible narrative this cycle is unveilings and IPO pricing out of China, but the harder evidence of the sector moving from demo to production is sitting one layer down, in lidar shipment volumes, connector and embedded-silicon production ramps, and new factory openings, none of which the current options coverage or the book's existing TSLA exposure has caught up to yet.
